York noun

late Latin

Eutr. 8.19 (Lewis & Short)
M-O s.v. York
Graesse, Orbis Latinus (1861), index s.v. York: Eboracum

Eborācum, Eborācī n.

noun, second declension

So New York is Novum Eborācum (Traupman 198). A town takes no preposition: Eborācum (to), Eborācī (in, at), Eborācō (from).

Other words

  • Eborācēnsis, Eborācēnse — of York

    also used · Renaissance · M-O s.v. York (Tursellinus 1652)

See also England.
